selected_source_rows.name: Measurement inside an interacting process
selected_source_rows.summary: Flux, charged matter and a scalar field on one register with complete instruments and feedback; certified nonzero infinite-occupation response.
selected_source_rows.why: Measurement is not outside physics: an observer is another subsystem doing repair, and the process is simulated end to end.

selected_source_rows.name: Periodic Y-readout response: frequency and amplitude
selected_source_rows.summary: Source-derived Palm reference with weights (5/13, 4/13, 4/13) and modular frequency log(5/4). A coherent preparation plus Y readout responds periodically: 1/2 − sin(s·log(5/4))/140 for C, 1/2 − sin(s·log(5/4))/220 for E.
selected_source_rows.why: Measured: the oscillation of a Y readout over modular time s: its frequency log(5/4) and its amplitude. Candidate readout of an observer's own modular ('felt') time - and it differs between record laws, so it could discriminate them too.

selected_source_rows.name: Joint readings of two event clocks (field-plus probability, tick ratio)
selected_source_rows.summary: Two local event clocks across observers keep complete quantum field outputs. C and E share the completed clock law but predict field-plus probabilities 35/54 vs 14/27 after three native attempts. Clock conversion: mean 2 B-ticks per two A-ticks, variance 16.
selected_source_rows.why: Measured: the field-plus probability after three attempts, and the tick conversion between two observers' clocks. Equal clock rates do not mean identical readings: clock comparison carries the full count distribution, as relativistic clock comparisons should.

selected_source_rows.name: Joint screen–reference interference under feedback (untouched reference alone unchanged)
selected_source_rows.summary: A logical qubit with untouched reference evolves through two native incident-clock ticks with record-controlled feedback; comparison bound below 7.779e-10. C and E: identical classical records, different reference coherences.
selected_source_rows.why: Measured: the coherence of an untouched reference qubit after two incident-clock ticks with record feedback. A single twelve-port carrier already supports an observer, repair, clocks and coherent records - federations are optional.

selected_source_rows.name: Seam-current covariance and Brownian path limit
selected_source_rows.summary: Seam currents mapped through the recovered rank-three frame have covariance (4N/99)·I3 and a Brownian path limit with action coefficient 99/8.
selected_source_rows.why: Measured: the covariance of seam currents in the recovered 3D frame, (4N/99)·I3, and its random-walk limit. Random repair currents average into isotropic 3D diffusion - a seed of kinetic behaviour.

selected_source_rows.name: Two-particle field statistics from incident-clock counting
selected_source_rows.summary: Counting every attempted repair at the observer region gives a positive effective transfer and controlled logarithm; complete four-read protocols on all 28,680 two-particle states of a 240-port federation; density 1/3 feedback reverses a connected statistic.
selected_source_rows.why: Measured: four-read field statistics on all 28,680 two-particle states, including feedback reversal. Effective field descriptions in an observer's own clock units emerge from counting local repair attempts. The proved execution covers the stated cap-one experiment.

selected_source_rows.name: Field-record correlations at unused time lags
selected_source_rows.summary: Exact correlations reconstruct a seven-dimensional cyclic positive transfer whose recurrence predicts unused lags.
selected_source_rows.why: Measured: correlations at time lags not used in the fit, predicted by the reconstructed seven-dimensional transfer. An observer can reconstruct a quantum Hamiltonian-like transfer purely from its record correlations.

selected_source_rows.name: Integer lift of the face register
selected_source_rows.summary: Proved and executed: the exact face-lift identities — lift mod 6 equals the stored class on every face of every stored cut (levels 4–7), and 0 of 68,515,840 carrier states have nonzero total. Diagnostic only (not promoted): 99.7% of defect faces hold a 6Y value of a Standard Model multiplet.
selected_source_rows.why: Most defect faces already carry a Standard Model hypercharge, but the lift is not a conserved label inside a class.
